architecture.title: Inference economics — from a streamed call to $/M-token, goodput and a trusted judge
architecture.caption: Everything divides by one measured number: YOUR decode tok/s. Lab01 turns watts × tariff ÷ throughput into $/M-token and compares it to a cloud list price; lab02 reframes cost as dollars per SUCCESSFUL task; lab03 checks that the judge scoring 'success' actually agrees with ground truth before you trust any of it.

sequence.title: Measure tok/s → derive $/M-token → price success → audit the judge
sequence.caption: The order matters: cost per raw token first, then cost per successful task, then proof that 'successful' was measured by a judge you can trust. Without the last step, chasing cheaper tokens silently buys worse outcomes.

steps.label: TTFT + exact usage tokens → decode tok/s (~42 tok/s on the course setup)
$0.238 electricity-only · $1.245 amortized vs $1.80 cloud per M-token
4 self-verifying micro-tasks, graded on the exact expected answer
measured success rate (timeouts count as failures — too slow IS a goodput miss)
judge all 5 golden answers (must FAIL '2+2=5' and '17=3×6')
verdicts vs ground truth → judge agreement, gated at 80%
below the 80% agreement gate → don't trust any goodput number built on this judge

charts.caption: TUTORIAL step 4 math at 240 W, $0.15/kWh, $3999 box over 3 years, 42 tok/s measured decode (dollar figures are illustrative teaching constants; the $1.80 cloud price is illustrative, not a quote). Amortization dominates electricity at single-stream tok/s — batching (App 03 · Dynamo) is the whole game.

charts.title: Throughput's second denominator — tokens/s per Megawatt
charts.caption: demos/step02_throughput.py SIM table (illustrative serving configs; in REAL the 1× row is YOUR measured tok/s). Per-GPU says 'did we tune the engine'; per-MW says 'how much product per grid connection' — the Spark's per-MW number is respectable because it sips 240 W.

charts.title: Goodput sensitivity — same sticker price, different success rates
charts.caption: lab02_goodput_bench.py's sensitivity table at the illustrative $0.45/M-token price and 300 tokens/attempt: $/attempt is $0.000135 regardless, but dropping from 95% to 35% success nearly TRIPLES the cost per result — the cheap-model trap in one chart.
